notes.title: Thank You!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Just want to give a big thank you to everyone who has played and left reviews for my visual novel. It means a lot to me just seeing others enjoying the experience, especially since this was my first story heavy game I made by myself. 

Making this game was sorta difficult for me because a lot of the experiences that Reina and Mizuki dealt with came from my past experience (loosing a friend through suicide, having to deal with those who looked down on disabled people, and having anxiety from abuse) but I think I did a decent job telling a compelling story that I hope brought a bit of joy to others. 

This visual novel was also originally created for a game jam which lasted about two months, though, I was only able to finish a little piece by the time the jam finished. I spent another month after the jam creating what you all played here and if possible I'd love to make a sequel or even add onto the base story. Any future instalments that I do for Wheel of Innocence (whether it's DLC or a sequel) will be completely free of course.

Right now I'm currently working on a new game called [b][i]Nhara[/i][/b], which is a 2D monochrome stealth-horror. I'll be posting updates about it on the game's itch.io page and on my MKShadowZX group page when I can, both links will be down below n.n

Thanks again for all the love and feedback,
Merik (MKShadowZX)

Itch.io game page: https://mkshadowzx.itch.io/nhara
Group Page: https://steamcommunity.com/groups/mkshadowzx

notes.title: Wheel of Innocence - Official Steam Release
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm happy to announce the official steam release for Wheel of Innocence is live right now! I'm excited for everyone to be able to play and if you experience any bugs feel free to create a discussion post about it.

Happy Gaming,
Merik (MKShadowZX)
